sections.text_helper: Section 9.1.5 "SYSCFG interrupt line 1 status register (SYSCFG_ITLINE1)" in chapter 9 (System configuration controller (SYSCFG)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 203.
sections.section_content:
This register is only available on STM32C071xx. On the other devices, it is reserved.
Address offset: 0x84
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 PVM_VDDIO2_OUT: VDDIO2 supply monitoring interrupt request pending (EXTI line 34)
Bit 0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
